source.description:
## PROBLEM

PR0-4 ship package + verifier + gate + index + dispatch integration. Without measurement, we cannot answer: does the verifier catch what it should? Is retrieval precision high enough? What's the stale-claim escape rate? Are agents actually consuming bundles?

Research §3.9 mandates a labeled eval corpus (80-150 cases from real closed issues / merged PRs / real alerts / incidents / drift history / diagnostic tasks) with a specific metric set. Research §3.7 requires retrieval telemetry (retrieval_events table) for ignored-activation rate, citation utilization rate, stale-claim escape rate. PR3 declared the table; this PR populates it with hooks and dashboards.

**Ponytail split**: canary policy for future auto-merge is a decision doc, not code. Split into PR5b — unblocks separately when operator ratifies thresholds. This PR (PR5a) is shovel-ready measurement + alert-to-service surface.

## SUCCESS

- Labeled eval corpus at ~/dev/xtrm/packages/service-knowledge/eval/corpus/ with 80-150 cases across: closed bd issues (bug + feature), merged PRs with operational changes, real Prometheus alerts (from mercury-infra history), incident reports, drift history, diagnostic tasks, past questions that produced wrong commands or claims.
- Each case labeled per §3.9: query_or_task, touched_paths, expected_services, required_evidence, forbidden_evidence, expected_probes, cross_repo_required, outcome.
- Eval harness runs the corpus against the shipped system and emits the 12 metrics from §3.9.
- Retrieval telemetry hooks emit to retrieval_events (PR3 table) on every knowledge_search/_get/_evidence_for_files call + on every activator invocation.
- Weekly report at .beads/eval-reports/YYYY-WW.md (raw values, week-over-week delta, threshold status green/yellow/red, corpus expansion suggestions).
- Alert-to-service routing tool (new small MCP wrapper): incident_routing takes an Alertmanager-shaped payload → knowledge_search → returns top-K service + runbook probes → evidence bundle. Advisory only.
- Post-merge reindex hook completes on mercury-infra + any other consumer that has installed (from operator-triggered wave-2 installs) within the 60s budget from PR3.

## SCOPE

- NEW: src/service_knowledge/eval/
  - corpus/*.json — labeled cases
  - harness.py — runs the corpus, computes metrics
  - metrics.py — metric definitions + aggregation
  - reports/  — output artifacts
- EXTEND: src/service_knowledge/index/query.py — telemetry emission on every query (PR3 declared the table; this PR populates it)
- EXTEND: src/service_knowledge/scripts/skill_activator.py — telemetry on inject + block + override decisions (from PR4)
- EXTEND: src/service_knowledge/scripts/verifier/ — FP/FN accounting hooks on golden-fixture runs
- NEW: ~/dev/xtrm/packages/service-knowledge/.github/workflows/eval-weekly.yml — cron running eval harness, publishing report as artifact + sticky-commenting summary on a tracking issue
- NEW: src/service_knowledge/mcp/incident_routing.py — thin wrapper over knowledge_search with alert-shape input
- Post-merge reindex wiring for mercury-infra + wave-2 consumers (extend PR3's hook or add if not wired)

## NON_GOALS

- No auto-merge ENABLE in this PR — canary policy is PR5b
- No embedding/vector rollout (metrics might trigger it — follow-up)
- No cross-repo aggregation switch (metrics might trigger it — follow-up)
- No new claim types in verifier (that's a PR1 follow-up if telemetry demands)
- No new MCP tools beyond incident_routing wrapper
- No security-auditor pipeline changes
- No operator dashboard UI beyond CSV/Markdown reports + optional Grafana panels

## CONSTRAINTS

- Eval corpus MUST include the 3 regression cases from the observed api-gateway/runners specialist failure
- Corpus cases MUST have permalinks to source artifacts (bd IDs, PR numbers, alert IDs, incident report paths)
- Metric definitions match §3.9 exactly — same names, same semantics
- Telemetry payloads: no PII, no raw query text (hash instead), no secret values per PR3 constraint
- Weekly report includes raw metric values, week-over-week delta, threshold status, corpus expansion suggestions from unclassified failures
- Alert-to-service tool must NOT trigger any mutation — advisory only until PR5b canary policy ships
- Logging/telemetry (meta): eval harness emits {timestamp, component=eval-harness, event=run|metric_computed, corpus_version, case_count, per_metric_value, duration_ms} → historical reports at .beads/eval-reports/YYYY-WW.md

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Corpus assembled: ≥ 80 cases with full labels; provenance links resolve
- [ ] Regression coverage: the 3 api-gateway failure classes appear in corpus and shipped verifier catches all 3
- [ ] Eval harness end-to-end: `service-knowledge eval run --corpus corpus/` produces report at .beads/eval-reports/YYYY-WW.md with all 12 metrics
- [ ] Baseline metrics measured and documented: routing precision ≥ 0.8, retrieval precision@5 ≥ 0.6, stale-claim escape rate ≤ 0.05, verifier FP ≤ 0.05, verifier FN ≤ 0.10 on corpus
- [ ] Weekly workflow smoke via workflow_dispatch: report artifact + tracking-issue comment
- [ ] Telemetry table populated: retrieval_events has rows after 1h of normal session activity (sqlite dump verify)
- [ ] Alert-to-service smoke: synthetic Alertmanager payload → knowledge_search finds correct service + probes → evidence bundle returned
- [ ] Post-merge reindex measured on mercury-infra + any wave-2 consumers; all ≤ 60s
- [ ] Structured telemetry: grep 'component=eval-harness' finds one line per run + per metric

## LIBRARIES

- Reuse: index/query.py (PR3), verifier module (PR1), drift_detector.py, Prometheus scrape configs (for alert payload shape reference)
- Installed deps: sqlite3 (stdlib), csv (stdlib)
- Stdlib: statistics for aggregation, pathlib, json
- New dep candidate: none — reports are Markdown/CSV
- Roll it: aggregation is trivial; corpus is JSON

## OUTPUT

- Eval corpus tree with all cases labeled + provenance
- Harness + metrics module
- Weekly workflow YAML
- Sample eval report (baseline week 0)
- Alert-to-service smoke transcript
- Metrics baseline dashboard link or CSV/MD path
- 90-day telemetry retention plan (or 'inherits from .beads/ default')
- Input into PR5b: baseline metrics that inform canary threshold decisions

## APPROACH NOTES

- Dispatch: sp run executor --bead xtrm-56flm.5 --worktree.
- Parallelization: blocked-by PR0/PR1/PR2/PR3/PR4 — runs in wave-4 as the measurement layer that everything else feeds.
- Corpus assembly: use gh + bd + Prometheus alertmanager API to bulk-extract raw material, then hand-label. Subset can be paired-labeled with LLM assist (operator reviews). One-time work.
- The 3 regression cases from api-gateway are the anchor; every other case is bonus but the regression must land.
- Alert-to-service is a natural fit for the Grafana Scenes incident dashboard from mercury-infra PR #234 — coordinate with operator on where the button/tool surfaces.
- Weekly reports as bd sticky comments on a long-lived tracking issue (create at PR start) rather than individual issues — avoids issue-board pollution.
